name: flowproof-fiori-fixture
description: Local, offline SAPUI5 fixture app used to evaluate flowproof's web-adapter reliability against UI5 idioms (growing tables, routing, dialogs/popovers, F4 value help). Not part of the flowproof product - a test fixture only. Framework libraries are resolved by ui5.yaml / the UI5 tooling framework cache, not npm - do not add @openui5/* here (ui5 tooling refuses to start if a framework library is also a direct npm dependency).
